sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT KIND OF PETS THE OTHER CALLER HAS.
turns: So, do you have any pets?
That's great! What kind of dog do you have?
Oh, I love golden retrievers! We used to have one when I was growing up. What's your dog's name?
Bella, that's such a beautiful name for a dog. How old is she?
Oh, she's still a young dog. What's she like? Is she energetic or more laid back?
She's very energetic and playful, but also loving and loyal.
That sounds like a great combination! Do you have any funny or memorable stories about her?
Well, there was that time when she stole a pair of my shoes and ran around the house with them in her mouth. It was pretty funny.
Oh, that's hilarious! Dogs can be so silly sometimes. What do you and Bella like to do together?
We like to go for walks, play fetch, and cuddle on the couch. She's a great companion.
That sounds like a wonderful relationship. I miss having a dog around sometimes. Do you have any other pets?
No, just Bella. She's my only pet, but she's a good one.
Well, Bella sounds like a great pet to have. Thanks for sharing about her!
You're welcome. It was nice talking about my pet.
Yes, it was nice talking to you too. Take care!
